history.reason: Part 12A fixed the 97-dependency catalogue, source owners, output rules, and reverse rollback order.
Parts 12B through 12F passed their required gates and Part 12G rendered-output checks began against synthetic sources.
Every Phase 12 dependency now has a machine-readable disposition; migration routes and controls are authoritative while Phase 13 rollback files remain retained.

read.condition: The migration notification, task, dashboard, report, preview, download, and print controls call only FastAPI routes. No migration screen imports a retained Supabase reader or browser renderer.
read.releaseCondition: Rollback disables migration controls and routes in reverse dependency order before a retained legacy reader returns.

write.condition: Migration output generation reads approved projections, appends protected audit metadata, streams complete bytes, and writes no output artifact or source-domain value.
write.releaseCondition: Rollback disables 12G render routes, 12F byte routes, 12E reports, 12D dashboards, 12C tasks, and 12B producers before restoring one retained legacy writer.

rollback.trigger: A Phase 12 authorization, source, determinism, limit, audit, delivery, log-safety, or cutover proof fails after cutover.

steps.action: Disable 12G rendered output routes and print controls, then 12F byte routes and 12B notification producers.
Restore one retained legacy producer only after its migration producer is disabled; generated output remains on demand and unpersisted.
Disable 12G, 12F, 12E, 12D, 12C, and 12B consumers in that order before restoring matching retained legacy readers.
Verify one read authority and one writer for each catalogue item; keep employee-detail and leave-calendar print unavailable.
Preserve source rows, notifications, read timestamps, audit events, snapshots, settlements, and renderer evidence without retaining output bytes.
